_about: Stock photography used for general website presentation (SRS: Mandatory Visual Asset and Image Implementation Plan). This file is the image source log: each key maps to its original Unsplash photo, licence and alt text. Optimised WebP copies live in src/static/images/photos/<key>-<width>.webp. Stock photos are NEVER presented as an actual Pablo Homes listing — sample listings are labelled, and real listings must use genuine photos in properties.json "images".
